svg.title: GRZ_Research · live BTC-USD limit order book
svg.desc: Live COINBASE level-2 order book for BTC-USD as two piles of particles under the cumulative depth curves, on a fixed price axis; mid 58,463.01 USD, bid wall 57,500.00 and ask wall 58,481.98. The mid replays the last 60 minutes: liquidity below it is bid, above it ask.
